assumptions.statement: The supplied 11.4 km² geometry is used only as a provisional working envelope, not as a statutory red line.
assumptions.impact: All precise areas and interfaces require official verification.
assumptions.resolution: Replace with authority-issued boundary before detailed design.

assumptions.statement: No seasonal biodiversity baseline or sensitive-species inventory was available.
assumptions.impact: The proposal sets a monitoring protocol, not species-count performance promises.
assumptions.resolution: Complete four-season surveys with qualified ecologists.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks and utility capacities remain unknown.
assumptions.impact: No statutory or engineering compliance claim is made.
assumptions.resolution: Reconcile with approved regulatory planning and specialist surveys.

assumptions.statement: AI outputs are advisory and may be wrong.
assumptions.impact: No automated enforcement, habitat intervention or public-safety decision is permitted.
assumptions.resolution: Named human reviewers, logs, appeal and non-digital fallback are mandatory.

assumptions.statement: External precedents are background cases rather than evidence about the Jing-Zhang site.
assumptions.impact: Transferability must be tested through reversible pilots.
